scripts.build:example: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react && npm test
scripts.check:static: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace @pwa-instructions/example-react && git diff --exit-code -- 'guides/**/install.svg' 'guides/**/instructions.md'
scripts.test:ci: npm run build:packages && mkdir -p test-reports && { node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-reports/junit.xml tests/*.test.mjs; s=$?; node scripts/junit-wrap.mjs test-reports/junit.xml unit || exit $?; exit $s; }
scripts.pack:package: npm run build:packages && npm pack --workspace pwa-instructions
